items.title: Near-duplicate / similarity detection
items.detail: Today FileHQ finds only byte-for-byte exact duplicates (matching xxhash64). Add perceptual / fuzzy matching so re-encoded videos, resized photos, and edited documents are surfaced as similar-not-identical groups. The HINT capability ('near-duplicate/similarity detection') is the headline gap between what FileHQ advertises and what it currently does.

items.title: Document content extraction + full-text search
items.detail: qi_registry.json advertises 'Document content extraction' and a 'File search API', but search today is only filename LIKE matching over the files table. Extract text from PDFs/Office docs and index it (full-text or vector) so Naya can answer 'which document mentions X?' not just 'which file is named X?'.

items.title: Content-aware categorization
items.detail: Categorization is extension-only. Use extracted content (and optionally NEXUS LLM analysis, already declared as a consumes_from_ecosystem dependency) to classify by what a file actually is, not just its suffix.

items.title: Reconcile FileHQ port (8000 vs 8200)
items.detail: config.py / run.py / main.py bind 127.0.0.1:8000 and qi_registry.json records port 8000, but filehq_bridge.py calls http://127.0.0.1:8200 and FileHQ_Master_Status_Report.md claims 8200. Pick one, fix the bridge or the launcher, and update the registry + Service Registry so Naya reliably reaches the engine.

items.title: Define the managed start/stop contract
items.detail: Document and codify exactly how Naya launches FileHQ (Naya_Control.bat option [8] / File Manager tab) and how is_running() health-checks it, so the engine is never silently offline when Naya needs it.

items.title: Phase 2 code absorption
items.detail: Registry family_notes: 'Phase 1 (bridge) complete. Phase 2 (code absorption) pending the owner approval.' Decide whether filehq/ stays a self-contained sub-package or is fully folded into Naya's modules + naya.db.

items.title: Seed real scheduled tasks
items.detail: The APScheduler wiring + tasks/task_runs tables exist but hold 0 rows. Register a recurring incremental scan (default 24h) and weekly dedup so the ~2.86M-file index stays fresh without manual triggering.

items.title: Auto-maintenance schedule
items.detail: Run maintenance.full_maintenance() (VACUUM + purge missing/resolved) on a schedule so the DB self-heals after large scans and deletions instead of only on a chat request.

items.title: Recycle-bin instead of hard delete
items.detail: execute_dedup_actions delete uses os.remove (permanent). Route deletes to the Windows Recycle Bin (e.g. send2trash) or a quarantine folder so an approved clean-up is still recoverable beyond the operations log.

items.title: Verify-before-act on stale paths
items.detail: With millions of indexed paths, some go stale between scan and action. Re-stat each file immediately before delete/move/rename and skip mismatches, to avoid acting on a path that has changed underneath the index.

items.title: Per-operation undo coverage audit
items.detail: operations carries reversible/undo_path/batch_id, but the dedup delete path doesn't capture an undo copy. Ensure every destructive action writes a genuine undo artefact before it runs.

items.title: Standard /health + /version endpoints
items.detail: is_running() pings /api/stats as a liveness proxy. Add explicit /health (JSON) and /version endpoints per QI standards so QI Hive Mission Control can monitor FileHQ like the other engines.

items.title: Register engine state in QI Brain
items.detail: Log scan/dedup runs and index size to the QI Brain so the ecosystem has cross-project visibility into FileHQ activity.

items.title: Retire the original C:\FileHQ
items.detail: Registry marks the original standalone path for deletion. Confirm nothing references C:\FileHQ (server_status() error text still says 'python C:\FileHQ\run.py') and remove it.
